title: 第23章 请先生教我第24章 总督部署
slug: 老乡你咋还会搓火球嘞
content_zh:
今晚的夜空还算晴朗。
江北的天气不像江南那样阴云多雨，入冬前大多是秋高气爽的凉爽。
夜风吹落了那原本还顽强不屈留在树枝上的银杏叶，张绝就踩着这些叶子来到了村西北的这片银杏林。
茅屋的院子中，杨先生就和昨晚一样，坐在门前的躺椅上，身上盖着一层厚实的毛毯。
听到脚步踩在银杏叶上的声音，他看起来一点也不觉得意外，平躺在躺椅上的头甚至都没抬起来去看来人是谁，只是淡淡说道。
“我和刘光行的师父，那个混账酒鬼一起跟着我们的师父学习的时候，就生活在像这样的银杏林里。”
“那个时候他就总是惹事，不是喝醉了不小心点着了屋子，就是假借洗澡的名义偷人家池塘里的鱼被抓。”
“我们的师父当时还很忙，城市里的工人、乡下的农民全都敬爱他，指望着他带着他们一起要回被扣押的工钱、被贪墨的粮食、被压榨所剩无几的休息日，他天天念叨着要驱除鼠妖，恢复神州，却日日在修补那些万恶鼠妖留下的烂摊子。”
“所以虽然酒鬼是师兄，我才是师弟，可每次捅出篓子，都是我要去给他擦屁股。没钱修屋子，就自己学着修，赔不起人家的鱼就去人家家里白干一天活，结果那个酒鬼酒喝光了，还得哭着求我让我去给他讨酒。”
张绝也没说话，他只是走进了院子，自己给自己搬来一个矮凳，坐在了杨先生身旁，安静地听这个更像是在发牢骚的老人讲故事。
“我也是贱性子，挨不住他哭求，居然还真的想办法去给他讨了。那时候粮食都不够人吃的，乡下谁家有多余的粮食来酿酒？我就去林子里摘树上的白果，然后学着把白果晒干，换钱给他到城市里买酒。”
“当时去给那个混账买酒的时候，我其实一直在想，师父说了，我们俩谁最后能修出来辰宗的气，谁就当辰宗行走，那个酒鬼怎么看都不能比我先修出来。”
“他整天喝酒瞎玩，辰宗的法永远都只是随便看看，从没仔细学过，最后肯定是我要留下当行走，而他被赶走。现在我对他好点，到时候他走的时候，我也好找个由头安慰他。”
“可结果，最后修成的人却是他！”
杨先生的声音终于在这个时候有了起伏，坐在一旁的张绝能听得出，即使到了现在，他对这样的结果依旧耿耿于怀。
“我走了，从那以后我和师父和辰宗再也没有了瓜葛，后来直到师父身死，我都不知道，也没去看过他最后一眼。”
“我知道师父是不想牵连我，但后面我还是要给那个酒鬼擦屁股，看着他上门在我面前吹嘘，炫耀。”
“就算是到现在，辰宗的道统眼见都要断了，罪魁祸首还是那个该死的酒鬼，我依旧要来弥补他犯下的错！”
杨先生这时终于从躺椅上坐起来，他看着张绝，表情冷淡。
“你本来和我一样，和这些事没关系，什么旧法，什么辰宗，站在新法职业者的角度，全都是该被扫进历史垃圾堆中的垃圾！”

“但现在，你既然自己非要参与进来，管这样的闲事，那也得看看自己够不够格才行，不然就凭你现在刚刚转职，初职最低的阶位，最后真的拿到了辰宗的道统又如何？”
张绝没有因为他的态度而心生不满，他明白杨先生说的其实一点没错。
转职成为职业者后，要想有人教，有人带，要么选军校生去学校给军阀卖力，要么选编外加入职业者队伍，给那些老牌编外职业者卖力。
眼前这位杨先生现在什么都不要，就愿意传授他一些东西，就算他把自己骂得狗血喷头，张绝都不会在意。
“请先生教我。”张绝认真地说。
看着张绝那双眼睛，杨先生那原本冷淡的脸色此时终于渐渐舒缓了下来。
他没有再多说其他，而是直接开口问道。
“报纸上说，你刚在公允教堂完成转职就接下了安焕然的那道任务，也就是说，你选的是编外？领术的时候，有没有给那帮吝啬鬼塞钱？”
content_en:
The night sky is quite clear tonight.
The weather in Jiangbei is not as cloudy and rainy as in Jiangnan. Before winter, the weather is mostly clear and cool.
The night wind blew off the ginkgo leaves that had remained stubbornly on the branches. Zhang Jue stepped on these leaves and came to the ginkgo forest in the northwest of the village.
In the courtyard of the thatched cottage, Mr. Yang was sitting on a lounge chair in front of the door just like last night, covered with a thick blanket.
Hearing the sound of footsteps stepping on ginkgo leaves, he didn't seem surprised at all. He didn't even raise his head from lying on the recliner to see who it was, he just said lightly.
"When I was studying with Liu Guangxing's master, that bastard drunkard, we lived in a ginkgo forest like this."
"At that time, he was always causing trouble. Either he accidentally lit the house on fire when he was drunk, or he was caught stealing fish from other people's ponds under the guise of taking a bath."
"Our master was still very busy at that time. Workers in the city and farmers in the countryside all respected him and expected him to take them back to get back the wages that were withheld, the grain that was stolen, and the few rest days that were squeezed. He talked about driving away the rat demons and restoring China every day, but every day he was repairing the mess left by those evil rat demons."
"So even though the drunkard is the senior brother and I am the junior brother, every time he messes up, I am the one who has to wipe his butt. If I don't have money to repair the house, I learn to repair it myself. If I can't afford to pay for the fish, I go to someone else's house and work for nothing. As a result, the drunkard drinks all the wine and has to cry and beg me to let me go and beg for him."
Zhang Jue didn't say anything. He just walked into the yard, brought a low stool for himself, sat next to Mr. Yang, and listened quietly to the story told by this old man who seemed more like he was grumbling.
"I was also a mean-spirited person. I couldn't resist his crying and begging, so I actually tried to find a way to beg for him. At that time, there was not enough food for people to eat. Who in the countryside had extra food to make wine? I went to the forest to pick ginkgo fruits on the trees, and then learned to dry the ginkgo fruits, and exchanged money for him to buy wine in the city."
"When I went to buy a drink for that bastard, I actually kept thinking that Master said that whoever of us can finally cultivate the Qi of Chen Zong will be the one who can walk as Chen Zong. No matter how you look at it, that drunkard can't cultivate it before me."
"He drinks and plays around all day long. He always just casually looks at Chen Zong's teachings and never studies them carefully. In the end, I will definitely stay and work as a walker, while he will be driven away. Now I should be nice to him, so that when he leaves, I can find a reason to comfort him."
"But in the end, he was the one who finally succeeded!"
Mr. Yang's voice finally rose and fell at this time. Zhang Jue, who was sitting aside, could hear that even now, he is still brooding about such a result.
"I left. From then on, I had nothing to do with Master and Chen Zong. Later, until Master's death, I didn't know about it, nor did I see him for the last time."
"I know Master doesn't want to implicate me, but I still have to wipe that drunkard's butt and watch him come to brag and show off in front of me."
"Even now, Chen Zong's orthodoxy is about to be broken, and the culprit is still that damn drunkard. I still have to make up for the mistakes he made!"
Mr. Yang finally sat up from the recliner. He looked at Zhang Jue with a cold expression.
"You are like me and have nothing to do with these things. The old method and the Chen Sect, from the perspective of a new method professional, are all rubbish that should be swept into the garbage heap of history!"
"But now, since you insist on getting involved and meddling in such nosy matters, you have to see if you are qualified. Otherwise, what if you just changed jobs and were at the lowest level in your first job, so what if you finally got the orthodoxy of Chen Sect?"
Zhang Jue was not dissatisfied because of his attitude. He understood that what Mr. Yang said was actually correct.
After changing jobs and becoming a professional, if you want someone to teach you,Someone will guide them, either to choose military students to go to school to work for the warlords, or to choose non-staff to join the professional team and work for those veteran non-staff professionals.
The Mr. Yang in front of him didn't want anything but was willing to teach him something. Even if he scolded him to pieces, Zhang Jue wouldn't care.
"Please teach me, sir." Zhang Jue said seriously.
Looking into Zhang Jue's eyes, Mr. Yang's originally cold expression finally relaxed.
He didn't say anything else, but asked directly.
"The newspaper said that you took over An Huanran's task just after completing your job transfer at the Fairness Church. In other words, you chose a non-staff position? When you were leading the profession, did you give money to those stingy people?"
